# Antimicrobial Prophylaxis for Urological Procedures

Single-dose antimicrobial prophylaxis is appropriate in the majority of uncomplicated urologic cases.

<Click here> AUA Surgery Abx Prophylaxis Guidelines

# If no prophylaxis recommended, enter order:

*No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended order

# Endoscopic procedures:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

< OR >
Ampicillin 2gram IV ONCE AND Gentamicin 5mg/kg IV ONCE Preop

# TRUSP Biopsy:

[Link to outpatient menu](prostate-biopsy-prophylaxis)

References:

- MVAHCS Urology Section (July 2023)
- Lightner DJ, et al. Best Practice Statement on Urologic Procedures and Antimicrobial Prophylaxis, The Journal of Urology (2019)
- Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 vol 70 pages 195-283
Therapy:
**Alternative for allergy to penicillin/cephalosporin:

Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment

Levofloxacin 500mg IVPB ONCE Preop

**Alternative for allergy to both cephalosporins and fluoroquinolones:

Clindamycin 900 mg and gentamicin 5mg/kg iv preop

**Additional single agents:

[Gentamicin 5mg/kg Weight Based Dosing Preop](surg-gentamicin-weight-based-dosing)

< OR >
Ciprofloxacin 400mg IV ONCE Preop

< OR >
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg po x1 give in clinic

< OR >
Fluconazole 400mg IV ONCE Preop

## Open/Robotic procedures:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

**Alternative for cephalosporin allergy:

Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment

Select alternative from Endoscopic procedures above

## Cystectomy/large bowel/vaginal procedures:

Cefazolin Weight Based IV ONCE AND Metronidazole 500mg IV ONCE Preop

**Alternative for cephalosporin allergy:

Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment

Levofloxacin 500mg IVPB ONCE Preop

## Implants:

Cefazolin Weight Based IV ONCE AND Gentamicin 5mg/kg IV ONCE Preop

**Alternative for cephalosporin allergy:

Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment

Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV ONCE AND Gentamicin 5mg/kg IV ONCE Preop

## Soak Solution for Penile Implant prior to implantation in OR

Penile Implant Soak (Gentamicin 50MG and Rifampin 500MG) prior to implantation
